look_here_first: Start with the tall airy gaura-like habit: a robust winter annual or sometimes biennial with white asymmetric 4-petaled flowers that fade pink, long floral tubes, and a long-exserted style.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: usually robust winter annual, sometimes biennial

lookalikes.differences: O. calcicola is perennial with a woody rootstock and strong limestone specialization; O. filiformis is usually annual/biennial and generally taller and airier.
